maddeler.e:
أتشاتم (form VI)
# أَتَشَاتَمُ (ʔatašātamu) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ta.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَاتَمَ (tašātama)
# أَتَشَاتَمَ (ʔatašātama) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ta.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاتَمَ (tašātama)
# أَتَشَاتَمْ (ʔatašātam) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.tam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَاتَمَ (tašātama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
